summary.text: Reintroduces `gh pr` CLI command with an interactive PR list (survey-driven select: PRs authored by viewer, review-requested, current branch), plus subcommands list/show/create/checkout. Root `pr` invocation now runs interactiveList() by default.
summary.source: PR description: 'this commit adds gh pr back with the caveat that it doesn't support closing'

summary.text: pr.go's interactiveList/pullRequests use client.GenericAPIRequest to hit GitHub's GraphQL endpoint (search + repository query) and client.FetchPullRequests/PullRequest for REST lookups; client itself not modified in this PR.
External dependency used to build interactive select menus for PR list, PR/action selection, and create-PR confirmation flow.
Used for currentBranch() and checkoutPr()'s fetch/checkout/config git.Run calls; unchanged by this PR.
interactiveList 'open in browser' action and show()/openInBrowser spawn an external OS process via exec.Command to open PR URLs; unchanged mechanism.

architectureImpact.text: Single-file change to command/pr.go reintroduces the `gh pr` command's default behavior as an interactive TUI (survey-based select prompts) sitting on top of existing, unmodified GraphQL/REST client, git, and browser-launcher integrations — no new packages or service boundaries added, just a new interactive control-flow layer (interactiveList) wired as the root pr command's Run handler, calling out to GitHub's API (external service, trust boundary) and shelling out to the OS browser/git binaries (process boundary) for actions the user selects.
